answer: Someone thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The mesa schedule is applied in river and trellis exposes each instalment. A farm of 2176 identities would post 2264 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
